method: Tool view_image of actual raw-ROI and label panels; green hub/red thin-terminal; grayscale unaltered original HDMI crop; visibility masks checked against visible obstruction
observations: Hub crosses coincide with mechanical axle in reviewed supervised examples.
Thin-terminal crosses follow the long reading end, not the thick counterweight.
Masked hub under screwdriver/occlusion is not treated as absent; only visible terminal supervised.
Dim/near/far/overexposed positives with no eligible label remain masked, not false negatives.
OSD lines and boxes are present in original captures; upper-right OSD partly overlaps some ROI background or outer face. No inpainting or label-from-OSD.
Session-median negative windows partly crop the circular negative objects in D/E; these remain valid no-gauge windows but do not certify robust full-object rejection.
limitations: 104 of236 crops visually spot checked, all236 checked numerically.
Original AI-assisted source coordinates are not independently human-certified gold.
Annotated face bbox is a proxy for auto-locator output.
No training or model evaluation performed by this adapter review.
